mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over a 3-month window signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7% over a 6-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 7% and stays there for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment above 7% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over a 4-month window signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining real consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over a 6-month window signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% and stays there for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of restrictive policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101 for 3 consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 101 and stays there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000,000 over a 6-month window signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 135,000,000 and stays there for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above 550,000 units over a 3-month window signals strengthening residential demand, supporting construction and related industries, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 550,000 and stays there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 210 over a 6-month window signals persistent inflation, prompting tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 210 and stays there for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained CPI increases above 210 (t-test p > 0.05).
